description.value: Lemonade Gluten Free Bakery is a dedicated celiac-friendly bakery on Cambie Street in Vancouver, producing gluten-free cakes, tarts, pastries, cookies, and bread. They also accommodate a wide range of other dietary needs including dairy-free, egg-free, nut-free, and vegan options, making it a rare all-inclusive stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions. Orders are placed online or by phone with advance notice and collected as in-store pickup.
